non_blocking_findings.finding: S90 semantic prose vs frozen semantics: plan SS3 (and PREREG yaml) prose reads S90 = CONC28(T) minus 'mean of CONC28 over the trailing 90 days', but the frozen thresholds were generated by the dossier's single-shot code as CONC(28) - CONC(90) over the daily PIT DV-share (dossier: 'S = CONC28 - CONC90'; pit_conc_gate_single_shot.py conc_at). These are different functions of the share series.
non_blocking_findings.why_not_blocking: gate_module.s90_at implements the threshold-generating semantics, declares it binding in the module docstring ('any other reading of the prereg prose would silently invalidate the threshold semantics and is forbidden'), is pinned by test_s90_definition_matches_dossier_code, and the build cross-check measured s90 max abs diff 0.0 vs the dossier at all 52 S0R stamps. The p70/p90 quantile calibration is only valid under the generating semantics; the implementation chose the only correct reading and disclosed it. The plan prose is the imprecise surface.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Label-list divergence vs the dispatch premise: the dispatch's mandatory label list (OUTCOME_EXPOSED_ANCESTRY + REPLICATION_NOT_PROSPECTIVE + EQUIVALENCE_DATA_RESTAGE_UNPROVEN + UNIVERSE_LISTED_AT_WINDOW_START) is not the plan's SS11 invariant. The plan mandates WINDOW_FOLD + OUTCOME_EXPOSED_ANCESTRY + REPLICATION_NOT_PROSPECTIVE/scored=False + FUNDING_WIRING and the dispatch itself instructs to verify the exact list against the plan.
non_blocking_findings.why_not_blocking: The plan is the cycle's registered law and its invariant is mechanically enforced (wiring.validate_labels + 3 tests). The substance of the dispatch's two extra labels is carried elsewhere in the plan: the universe law is SS4 (PIT_LISTED_AT_WINDOW_START; S0R listed-at-start = full 20/20 universe, no divergence per A5), and the data-restage authority law is SS9 (per-fold scans, read-only catalogs). EQUIVALENCE_DATA_RESTAGE_UNPROVEN is the CHR3F-A3 cycle label; this cycle's rows are governed by the plan's own SS11 set. Future produced rows must carry the SS11 four labels exactly.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Plan SS10 step 3 says the build writes 'gate series + 200 random controls ... with digests'; the implementation serializes only the observables and generates the 200 permutations deterministically at cell time (seed = sha256('ILLIQ-REG-V1')[:8]; structure/determinism unit-tested).
non_blocking_findings.why_not_blocking: Disclosed in IMPLEMENT_HANDOFF known_limitations; PREREG requires only a 'declared, reproducible' seed, not serialization; determinism of the generation is unit-tested (same seed -> identical list; structure preservation: length, toggle count, min run 4, start state). The random gates bound PnL surfaces only, which do not exist pre-GO.

non_blocking_findings.finding: rvol30 window semantics: the frozen module uses completed closes strictly before the stamp (PIT); the dossier's descriptive single-shot replay read closes <= stamp, which at a Monday 00:00Z stamp includes the stamp day's own final 15m close (future data at the stamp). V2 states therefore differ at 3/52 S0R stamps and the GATE_OFF run is 9 stamps (2025-06-23..2025-08-18) vs the single-shot's 6 (from 2025-07-14).
non_blocking_findings.why_not_blocking: Disclosed verbatim in gate_series.json cross_check.rvol_semantics_note and in the handoff; S90 is bit-identical; the strictly-PIT reading is the no-lookahead-correct one (pinned by test_no_lookahead_mutation) and the frozen module is the cycle law; the delta direction is conservative (more flat weeks on the falsification surface, i.e. the gate shields more of the tail it was designed to avoid).

non_blocking_findings.finding: Frozen constants are roundings of the dossier's full-precision quantiles: 0.02131720710... -> 0.021317, 0.05770158... -> 0.057702, 0.32893024... -> 0.328930; falsification bars -0.2947 / 0.4372 vs exact 50%/30% derivations -0.294656 / 0.437155.
non_blocking_findings.why_not_blocking: The rounded values are themselves the preregistered frozen law and are identical across plan SS3/SS6, PREREG yaml, gate_module.py, the M0 tests, and every artifact digest; max effect < 1e-4 on any bar. No surface diverges from any other surface.
